extensionDescription.message: Generate Lua import files directly from Steam Store game pages using the FluentLuaBridge service.

buttonTooltip.message: Generate an import file with Fluent Steam Lua

errorUnavailableDetail.message: Open Fluent Steam Lua and enable Store page one-click import in Settings.

errorMethodDetail.message: The bridge does not accept this request method.

errorAppIdDetail.message: The game could not be identified. Open its main Store page.

errorNotFoundDetail.message: Update the bridge service and try again.

errorJobDetail.message: The import task was cleared. Click import again.

errorWindowDetail.message: The bridge could not create its window. Restart the feature in Settings.

errorConnectionDetail.message: The bridge may have exited. Turn the feature off and on again in Settings.

hintBody.message: Open Fluent Steam Lua, enable Store page one-click import in Settings, then try again.
